capabilities: Open daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly and yearly notes from a clickable calendar
Import existing configuration from Periodic Notes or core Daily Notes
Validate and one-click-fix date formats, including ISO week tokens and subfolder patterns
Show existence dots on every period and match notes by title or frontmatter date
Open notes via obsidian:// URIs with configurable pane placement
disambiguation: Not a menstrual cycle tracker; it is a calendar for navigating and creating daily-to-yearly notes.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13 or later for the declarative settings screen; older versions get 0.2.0 with the same calendar but a different settings UI. The old plugins can stay installed alongside without conflict.
intentEvidence: If you use Periodic Notes for monthly, quarterly or yearly notes, you have probably wanted a calendar
motivation: The author built it because the most requested features in the Calendar and Periodic Notes issue trackers — clickable months, quarters and years, and the week-format bug — were never fixed by those plugins.
problem: Existing calendar plugins only made days and weeks clickable, and locale/ISO week format mixing silently produced duplicate or unopenable weekly notes every January.

relations.evidence: Migrating from Calendar or Periodic Notes

summary: Calendar view where day, week, month, quarter and year are all clickable to open periodic notes, with ISO week format validation.
